text: The purpose of this staff report is to report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing & Standards in the matter of an application for a Sidewalk Café permit with deck at 240 Queen Street West, St. Patrick's Market laneway.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed Sidewalk Café permit with deck at 240 Queen Street West, St. Patrick's Market laneway.
